semiconductor_relevance: High — Qualmax specializes in test interface hardware, which is critical for semiconductor testing processes.
summary: Qualmax Taiwan Limited designs and manufactures custom test interface hardware, including spring contact probes and test sockets, aimed at enhancing semiconductor testing efficiency. Established in 1986, the company serves top-tier IDMs and OSATs globally, focusing on high-quality, competitively priced solutions.
